name: Crisis preemption

subjectOf.text: Dynamic elements can help anticipate and preempt financial crises by changing the timing of regulation, the availability and quality of information, and the emphasis of regulation.
subjectOf.abstract: Dynamic elements in financial regulation may even help anticipate and/or preempt financial crises by changing the timing, availability and quality of information, and the emphasis of regulation.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2273857
scope_conditions: dynamic elements actually change timing and information flows

subjectOf.text: Depending on their design, contingent capital securities can function as an early warning system that helps preempt financial crises.
subjectOf.abstract: Depending on the respective CoCo designs, CoCos can function as an early warning system to preempt financial crises.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Dynamic Regulation of the Financial Services Industry (2013). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2273857
scope_conditions: CoCo trigger design is institution specific and automatic
